_about: Descriptions for the Larry Seyer Drums OSC reference page. Edit text here, then run build_osc_page.py. Families describe address leaves shared by several bases; sections describe single addresses. '{values}' in a description is replaced by the collapsed values.

withheld.adf1574d7ad288a1: leaf names a third-party sample engine
withheld.947ca39bbfcd0ce3: address contains a trademarked wireless standard name

families.title: Players
families.intro: Larry Seyer Drums has four players, numbered 1-4 in these addresses.

rows.enabled: Turn the player on or off.
rows.drumsolo: Drum solo mode on or off.
rows.drumelementmutes: Bit mask of muted drum elements.
rows.drumelementsolos: Bit mask of soloed drum elements.
rows.outputbus: Output pair the player is routed to.
rows.morph/build: Status of the kit's morph build.
rows.kit/path: File path of the loaded kit.
rows.kit/snapshot: File path of the kit preset in use.
rows.kit/snapshotid: ID of the kit preset in use.
rows.kit/index: Catalog index of the loaded kit.
rows.preset/id: ID of the player preset the player shows.
rows.audition: Play a single drum element (by element number).
rows.pf/markermask: Diagnostic: bars of the pattern that carry a lift.
rows.pf/snarenote: Diagnostic: the groove's snare note (-1 when none).
rows.pf/patternbars: Diagnostic: bars in the current pattern.
rows.pill/name: Name of the pill playing on this player's lane.
rows.pill/pattern: Content of the pill playing on this player's lane.
rows.kit/resident: Kit file the sampler actually has loaded.
rows.fill/capturedmiss: Diagnostic: automatic fills that found no matching fill.
rows.fill/starvation: Diagnostic: fill draws that came back empty.
rows.fill/capturedstyle: Diagnostic: style preloaded for automatic fills.
rows.fill/capturedbagsize: Diagnostic: fills preloaded for automatic fills.
rows.fill/subdivision: Diagnostic: feel (straight or triplet) fills are matched to.
rows.energy: Energy level 0-6 of the pill playing on this lane.
rows.output/midi/enabled: Send this player's notes as MIDI.
rows.output/sampler/enabled: Play this player through the sampler.
rows.output/synth/enabled: Play this player through the drum synth.

families.title: Drum synth (per player)
families.intro: Each player has a built-in drum synthesizer. Players are numbered 1-4.

rows.soloslot: Solo one kit slot on the synth (-1 for none).
rows.routing: Diagnostic: whether the synth is enabled and which kit slots are assigned to it.

families.title: Mixer: channels, buses, master and effect returns
families.intro: Every mixer strip shares one set of controls. Instrument channels are numbered 0-95 (24 per player: player 1 uses 0-23, player 2 uses 24-47 and so on). Player buses are 0-3. Effect returns are 0-15, four per player: the first three of each player are reverbs and the fourth is the delay.

rows.eq/enabled: Turn the strip EQ on or off.
rows.eq/latency: Latency the EQ adds, in samples.
rows.eq/align: Latency alignment applied to this strip, in samples.
rows.eq/analyzeractive: 1 while the EQ spectrum analyzer is running.
rows.comp/enabled: Turn the strip compressor on or off.
rows.comp/schpf: Compressor sidechain high-pass filter on or off.
rows.send/<0-3>: Send level to the player's effect return 0-3 (reverbs 0-2, delay 3).
rows.output: Output pair the strip is routed to.
rows.limiter/enabled: Turn the limiter on or off.
rows.diag/peakpretape: Diagnostic: peak before the tape stage.
rows.diag/peakposttape: Diagnostic: peak after the tape stage.
rows.available: 1 when the return's effect is available on this device.
rows.granted: 1 when the reverb processing budget granted this return (a delay is always granted).
rows.runtimeactive: 1 while the return's effect is running.
rows.eq/on: 1 when the return's EQ is active.
rows.comp/on: 1 when the return's compressor is active.
rows.delay/enabled: Turn the delay on or off.
rows.delay/sync: 1 locks the delay time to the tempo; 0 uses milliseconds.
rows.delay/note: Synced note division, 0 (1/32) to 13 (whole); default 4 (1/8 triplet).
rows.delay/timems: Free delay time (ms), used when sync is off.
rows.vrDecayHeld: Hold decay at its own value instead of following the space.
rows.vrPredelayHeld: Hold pre-delay at its own value.
rows.vrBrightnessHeld: Hold brightness at its own value.
rows.vrWidthHeld: Hold width at its own value.
rows.vrSourceSet: 1 when custom source positions are set.

eq/scsource.reviewed: registered only where the strip config has eqBandList; channel, bus, master and return configs all do

eq/latency.reviewed: registered only where the strip config has eqBandList; channel, bus, master and return configs all do

eq/align.reviewed: registered only where the strip config has eqBandList; channel, bus, master and return configs all do

eq/analyzeractive.reviewed: registered only where the strip config has eqBandList; channel, bus, master and return configs all do

vrPredelayValue.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrBrightnessValue.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrWidthValue.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrMix.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrModDepth.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrOutputGain.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrColoration.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrDecayHeld.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrPredelayHeld.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrBrightnessHeld.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

vrNumSources.reviewed: registered at run time only for that return type

families.title: Advanced compressor
families.intro: The advanced compressor (separate from the simple strip compressor above) is available on the master, each player bus, each instrument channel and each effect return.

rows.enabled: Turn the compressor on or off.
rows.latency: Latency the compressor adds, in samples.
rows.stereoLinkHeld: Hold the stereo link at its own value.
rows.scPostFader: Take the sidechain after the fader.
rows.midAuto: Automatic mid band on or off.
rows.ratioHeld: Hold the ratio at its own value instead of following Character.
rows.attackHeld: Hold the attack at its own value.
rows.releaseHeld: Hold the release at its own value.
rows.kneeHeld: Hold the knee at its own value.
rows.meter/in/overload: Input overload light; write 0 to clear.
rows.meter/out/overload: Output overload light; write 0 to clear.
rows.sc/late: Diagnostic: 1 if the sidechain arrived late.

families.title: Tape machine
families.intro: The tape machine is available on the master and on each player bus.

rows.enabled: Turn the tape machine on or off.
rows.tapestop/active: 1 while a tape stop is running.

families.title: Reverb (player 1 shortcuts)
families.intro: Direct reverb controls for player 1's three reverbs (0-2). Every player's reverbs are also reachable through the effect returns above.

rows.decay/held: Hold decay at its own value.
rows.predelay/held: Hold pre-delay at its own value.
rows.brightness/held: Hold brightness at its own value.
rows.width/held: Hold width at its own value.
rows.diag/anchor: Diagnostic: space the engine actually loaded.
rows.diag/decay: Diagnostic: decay the engine is using.
rows.diag/outputformat: Diagnostic: output format the engine is using.

families.title: Song pills
families.intro: Pills are the sections placed on each player's lane of the song timeline. Lanes are 1-4 and pills are numbered from 0 in timeline order.

rows.triggerCcNumber: MIDI CC that triggers the pill.
rows.preFill: Play a fill before the pill.
rows.lastFill: Play a fill in the pill's last bar.
rows.move: Move the pill to a bar.
rows.resize: Set the pill's length in bars.
rows.speed: Playback speed as a ratio, e.g. 1/2 or 2/1.
rows.energy: Energy level the pill is playing.
rows.energy/stored: Stored energy response for the current global energy.
rows.regrid: Re-fit the pill to the grid.
rows.name: The pill's name.
rows.beats: Length in counted beats under the meter in force.
rows.storedLevel/<0-6>: Stored response for global energy level 0-6.

families.title: Sound slots (selected player)
families.intro: The 32 sound slots of the selected player's kit, numbered 0-31.

rows.element: Swap the sample by its place in the compatible list.
rows.changesample: Open the change-sample sheet for this slot.
rows.deepdive: Open the detailed sound editor for this slot.
rows.editdock: Open the tuning dock for this slot.

sections.title: Connection and OSC settings
sections.intro: Check the connection and change OSC settings remotely.

rows./drums/ping: Echo test: send any integer and the same value comes back.
rows./drums/settings/osc/enabled: Turn OSC control off (0) or on (1).
rows./drums/settings/osc/port: Receive port (1024-65535). Replies go to this port plus one.
rows./drums/settings/osc/listening: Port Larry Seyer Drums is listening on, or 0 when OSC is off.

sections.title: Transport, tempo and master
sections.intro: Playback, tempo, time signature and the global master controls.

rows./drums/transport/tempo/modulated: Tempo actually playing, including any tempo changes.
rows./drums/transport/tap: Tap tempo: each message is one tap.
rows./drums/transport/loop/active: 1 when the host loop is on.
rows./drums/swing/global: Swing percent applied to every player.

sections.title: Sync
sections.intro: Clock source, sync offsets, network tempo sync and timecode.

rows./drums/sync/offset/linkin: Offset for incoming network tempo sync (ms).
rows./drums/sync/offset/linkout: Offset for outgoing network tempo sync (ms).
rows./drums/sync/offsets: All five offsets plus the measured device latency.
rows./drums/sync/latency: Measured output latency, and what the system reports.
rows./drums/sync/midiclock/synced: 1 while locked to incoming MIDI clock.
rows./drums/link/enabled: Network tempo sync on or off.
rows./drums/link/startstopsync: Share start and stop over network tempo sync.
rows./drums/link/peers: Number of connected network tempo sync peers.

sections.title: MIDI
sections.intro: MIDI devices, channels and remote-control mappings.

rows./drums/midi/input/enable: Enable or disable an input: "name|1" or "name|0".
rows./drums/midi/output/device: Choose the MIDI output by name.
rows./drums/midi/virtualports/state: Status of the virtual MIDI ports.
rows./drums/midi/pcchannel: MIDI channel for Program Change and Bank Select.
rows./drums/midi/activity: Counts of incoming program, bank and transport messages.
rows./drums/midi/notechannelmask: Bit mask of MIDI channels allowed to play drum elements.
rows./drums/midi/bankselectmode: Bank Select mode: 0 = CC 0 value is the bank, 1 = standard.
rows./drums/midi/pilltrigger: Press remote pill-trigger button 0-3, as CC 101-104 would.
rows./drums/midi/fadercc: Assign mixer faders to MIDI CCs on channel 10.

sections.title: Audio device and output
sections.intro: Audio device selection and output layout.

rows./drums/audio/output/device: Choose the audio output device by name.
rows./drums/audio/output/none: Close the audio output (1) or reopen it (0).
rows./drums/audio/nodeviceclock: 1 when no audio device is open and the internal clock drives the engine.

rows./drums/click/accent/sound: Sound for the first beat of the bar.
rows./drums/click/accent/file: Custom sound file for the first beat.
rows./drums/click/beat/file: Custom sound file for the other beats.
rows./drums/click/output: Output pair: 0 = outputs 1-2 up to 31 = outputs 63-64.
rows./drums/click/output/state: Status of the chosen output pair.
rows./drums/click/listen: Play one bar of the click.
rows./drums/click/stats: Clicks played since launch and their levels.
rows./drums/song/click: Press the Songs page click button.

sections.title: Songs and banks
sections.intro: Load, save and organize songs and banks, and follow song playback.

rows./drums/song/load: Load the song in a slot.
rows./drums/song/save: Save the current song under a name.
rows./drums/song/program: Recall song 0-99 in the current bank (as a Program Change).
rows./drums/song/bank/slots: Occupied slots in the current bank.
rows./drums/song/slot/delete: Clear a slot (locked slots are kept).
rows./drums/song/slot/lock: Lock or unlock a slot: "index|1" or "index|0".
rows./drums/song/activeplayers: Bit mask of lanes playing a pill now.
rows./drums/song/endbehavior: At the end of the song: 0 = loop song, 1 = loop last bars, 2 = stop.
rows./drums/song/launchquantize: When a triggered pill starts: 0 = end of pill, 1 = next bar, 2 = two bars, 3 = four bars.
rows./drums/song/autofillonpillchange: Play a fill when a remote trigger changes the pill (0/1).
rows./drums/song/grid/open: Song grid: 0 = close, 1 = open to load, 2 = open to save.
rows./drums/song/grid/tap: Tap a slot in the open song grid.
rows./drums/song/track/<1-4>/loopanchor: Where the lane's loop is anchored.

sections.title: Song timeline editing
sections.intro: Arrange pills, time signature changes and styles on the song timeline.

rows./drums/song/ruler/beats: Beats the ruler shows in each visible bar.
rows./drums/song/conductor/delete: Delete the change at a bar.
rows./drums/song/conductor/droppillatrelease: Drop a pill where a drag is released: "lane,bar,num,den".
rows./drums/song/conductor/clear: Clear every pill and meter change.
rows./drums/song/pool/style: Pick a style for a pool column: "column,style".
rows./drums/song/pool/style/delete: Ask to delete a pool column's style.
rows./drums/song/pool/blankverse: Create a blank pattern set for a pool column.
rows./drums/song/shake: Ask to clear the song (as shaking the device does).

sections.title: Pattern editor
sections.intro: Edit the notes and feel of a pill. Open the editor with lane*1000 + pill.

rows./drums/song/editor/open: Open the editor on a pill (lane*1000 + pill).
rows./drums/song/editor/feel/swing: The pill's swing percent, or none.
rows./drums/song/editor/feel/offset: The pill's timing offset in beats, or none.
rows./drums/song/editor/snap: Snap on or off, or a grid value.
rows./drums/song/editor/zoombutton: Press a zoom button: h-, h+, v- or v+.
rows./drums/song/editor/notes: Notes shown compared with notes stored.
rows./drums/song/editor/rowgesture: Automation: a gesture on a drum row.
rows./drums/song/editor/seekbar: Move the play cursor to a bar.
rows./drums/song/editor/rows: Show used rows or all rows.
rows./drums/song/editor/rowclear: Clear every row solo and mute.
rows./drums/song/editor/selection: Act on selected notes: delete, copy, clear or move.
rows./drums/song/editor/toggleatcursor: Add or remove the note at the cursor.
rows./drums/song/editor/group: Fold or unfold an instrument group (0 kick to 5 other).

sections.title: Energy
sections.intro: Energy levels shape how hard each player plays. There are seven levels, 0 (Asleep) to 6 (Energetic). Profile parameters with a trailing <0-3> are per player (0-based).

rows./drums/energy/player/<0-3>/default: Default energy level for a player (0-based).
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/factory: 1 while the level matches the factory setting.
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/elementmutes: Muted drum elements per player (bit mask).
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/groupVelocit: Velocity percent per player and instrument group 0-7.
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/groupTimingM: Timing offset (ms) per player and instrument group 0-7.
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/instrumentVe: Velocity percent per player and instrument. <instrument> is one of: {values}.
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/instrumentTi: Timing offset (ms) per player and instrument. <instrument> is one of: {values}.
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/timingoffset: Timing offsets: value for the chosen step.
rows./drums/energy/profile/<0-6>/velocityscal: Velocity scales: value for the chosen step.

sections.title: Sounds and kits
sections.intro: Kits, samples and the drum synth pages for the selected player.

rows./drums/sounds/element/query/index: Sample lookup: choose the list position.
rows./drums/sounds/changesample/currentrow: Row of the loaded sound in the change-sample sheet.

sections.title: Presets, Quick Pick and app setups
sections.intro: Player presets, Quick Pick and saved audio/MIDI setups.

rows./drums/presets/player/load/replacemixer: Load a player preset and replace the mixer settings.
rows./drums/presets/player/load/keepmixer: Load a player preset and keep the current mixer settings.
rows./drums/presets/player/generate/source: Player preset whose mixer settings every generated preset takes (empty = the selected player).
rows./drums/presets/player/generate/state: Result of the last generate run.
rows./drums/quickpick/note: Pick a Quick Pick beat or preset by its MIDI note number.
rows./drums/quickpick/show: Hide (0) or show (1) the Quick Pick panel.
rows./drums/appsettings/presets: Saved app setups, and the last save or load result.
rows./drums/appsettings/save: Save the current app setup under a name.
rows./drums/appsettings/current: App setup in use, and whether it has changed.

rows./drums/settings/morphmode: Drum morphing: 0 = automatic, 1 = always on, 2 = always off, 3 = random.
rows./drums/settings/morphheadroom/verdict: Automatic morphing verdict for this machine.
rows./drums/settings/morph/drum/<drum>: Morphing for one drum on or off. <drum> is one of: {values}.
rows./drums/settings/playerpresetoverwrite: Allow saves to replace an existing player preset.
rows./drums/partialfills/phrase: Lift phrase length in bars (1-32, default 4).
rows./drums/partialfills/recipes: Lift recipes: "factory" or a custom list.

sections.title: Import and export
sections.intro: Import and export songs, styles, MIDI and audio.

rows./drums/song/loadfile: Load a song from a file path.
rows./drums/ui/export/song: Export the current song to a file path.
rows./drums/import/midifile: Import a MIDI file as a new style.
rows./drums/song/lane/importmidi: Import a MIDI file onto a lane: "lane|bar|path".
rows./drums/import/notemap/pick: Pick a saved note map (-1 = new).
rows./drums/export/timeline/midi: Export the song as MIDI: "path" or "path|gm".
rows./drums/export/pills/dragout: Export pills as a drag-out clip; reads back the file path.
rows./drums/song/pillmidi/ex: Pill MIDI note layout: 1 = Larry Seyer Drums note layout, 0 = standard drum note layout.
rows./drums/export/timeline/audio/measured: Loudness and peak of the last audio export.

sections.title: Effect availability and defaults
sections.intro: Whether the heavier effects can run on this device, and new-song effect defaults.

rows./drums/fx/tape/capable: 1 when this device can run the tape machine.
rows./drums/fx/vcomp/capable: 1 when this device can run the advanced compressor.
rows./drums/fx/vcomp/capacity: How many advanced compressors this device can run.
rows./drums/diag/tape/fraction: Diagnostic: processing load of the tape machines.
rows./drums/diag/vcomp/fraction: Diagnostic: processing load of the advanced compressors.
rows./drums/mixer/fxreturn/defaultsroot: Folder where new-song effect defaults are kept.
rows./drums/mixer/fxreturn/<1-4>/savedefault: Save effect return 1-4 as the new-song default.

sections.title: Keyboard shortcuts
sections.intro: Change shortcut bindings remotely. Every shortcut action can also be triggered directly (see Actions below).

rows./drums/keybinding/<action id>: The shortcut assigned to an action; send a key description to change it.
rows./drums/keymap/export: Export shortcuts to a file path.
rows./drums/keymap/import: Import shortcuts from a file path.
rows./drums/keymap/status: Result of the last shortcut change.
rows./drums/player/solo_preview_held: Hold (1) or release (0) Solo In Front for the selected player.

sections.title: User interface automation
sections.intro: Open, close and operate on-screen panels and read back what they show. These are mainly useful for scripted testing and remote operation.

rows./drums/ui/page: Show a page by name; reads back the current page.
rows./drums/ui/player/<1-4>/card/tap: Tap a control on a player card.
rows./drums/ui/player/<1-4>/badge: A player card's mute and solo badges.
rows./drums/ui/player/soundkit/menu: Open a player's sound kit menu.
rows./drums/ui/preferences/reveal: Scroll App Settings to a section.
rows./drums/ui/attached: 1 while this window is attached as the live editor.
rows./drums/ui/licenses: Close (0) or open (1) the license viewer.
rows./drums/ui/licenses/document: Show a license document by index.
rows./drums/ui/settings/click/menu: Open a menu in the click settings.
rows./drums/ui/overflowmenu: Close (0) or open (1) the main menu.
rows./drums/ui/overflowmenu/hold: Press and hold a main menu row.
rows./drums/ui/keyboardshortcuts/reveal: Scroll the keyboard shortcuts to an action or group.
rows./drums/ui/mixer/subtab: Mixer sub-tab: panwid, sends, eq, cmp or level.
rows./drums/ui/mixer/player: Player whose strips the mixer shows (1-4).
rows./drums/ui/mixer/link: Add a channel to the linked selection.
rows./drums/ui/mixer/param: Move a control on a channel: "channel name value" (linked channels follow).
rows./drums/ui/mixer/eq/verdict: Result of the last EQ editor command.
rows./drums/ui/energyeditor: Close (0) or open (1) the energy editor.
rows./drums/ui/energyeditor/open: Open the energy editor on a section.
rows./drums/ui/energyeditor/scroll/wheel: Scroll the energy editor with the wheel.
rows./drums/ui/energyeditor/scroll/drag: Scroll the energy editor by dragging.
rows./drums/ui/spectrum/fullscreen: Full-screen spectrum analyzer off or on.
rows./drums/ui/reverb/browser/open: Close (0) or open (1) the reverb browser.
rows./drums/ui/reverb/panel: Close (0) or open (1) the reverb panel.
rows./drums/ui/tape/panel: Close (0) or open (1) the tape machine panel.
rows./drums/ui/song/compact/step: Step through the compact song launcher.
rows./drums/ui/sounds/synth/select: Pick synth machine 1-9 for the selected player.
rows./drums/ui/sounds/cell/empty: Drum grid cells the kit cannot play.
rows./drums/ui/sounds/cell/pads: How the drum grid pads are drawn.
rows./drums/ui/sounds/saveas: Save the sounds preset under a new name.
rows./drums/ui/menu/tapflash: Tap a menu row with its highlight.
rows./drums/ui/menu/searchfocus: 1 while the menu search field has focus.
rows./drums/ui/menu/search: Type into the menu search field.
rows./drums/ui/sync/source: Pick a sync source by its label.

sections.title: Testing and diagnostics
sections.intro: Performance readings, self-tests and state checks.

rows./drums/perf/cpu/peak: Peak processing load in the current window.
rows./drums/perf/near80: Times the load came close to the limit.
rows./drums/selftest/registry/writables: List writable addresses, one page at a time.
rows./drums/hoststate/capture: Capture the state a host would save.
rows./drums/hoststate/anchor: Bank and slot the live song belongs to.
rows./drums/screenshot: Save a screenshot of the window under a name.
rows./drums/song/editor/selftest: Fill the editor with a test velocity range.
rows./drums/song/editor/selftestarticulations: Fill the editor with every articulation.

_about_hashes: withheld keys and banned_hashes are sha256(lowercase text)[:16], so third-party names never appear in this repo. Add one with: python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256('word'.lower().encode()).hexdigest()[:16])"
